messages:
alex: heads up, deploy-bot flagged canary group C failing 3/5 smoke e2es, holding promo :warning:
maya: on it, link?
alex: https://ci.internal/redwood/pipelines/6321/builds/9876 — logs show timeout in payments-e2e and an artifact fetch 404 from artifact-cache
sam: saw that earlier, cache misses + a flaky DB seed in canary runner. logs: ```ERROR: GET https://artifacts.redwood/snapshots/sha256:bad123 => 404```
jordan: deploybot says promote step C -> D blocked: `promote: reconcile failed (cache-mismatch)`
maya: can you paste the deploy-bot output?
deploybot: [bot] promote_attempt(2026-03-21T15:07Z) failed: manifest-digest-mismatch for image redwood/api:canary-20260321 -> expected sha256:6f7a... got sha256:7b2e...
alex: that explains the 404 — registry has multiple partial uploads, looks like a multipart finalize race. we've seen this with S3 multipart replays during heavy CI traffic
sam: quick question — is this a CI build artifact issue or a registry replication one?
jordan: initial triage: CI produced artifact A with digest X, our promotion path looked up cached manifest Y due to cache-stamp drift on the artifact-indexer
maya: so pipeline progressed to promote but the indexer returned stale entry pointing to old blob that was GC'ed
release-coordinator: suggested options: A) pin to last-good image sha256:6f7a..., B) rollback canary to previous tag, C) force-promote after manual reupload + indexer flush (risky during change window)
alex: my vote: pin and re-run canary tests. we avoid full rollback and avoid manual indexer surgery during change window.
sam: pin looks safest. how long to pin and run?
maya: I can pin tag -> `api:canary` => `sha256:6f7a...` and re-trigger canary smoke within ~10m, then watch for the same e2e flake.
jordan: note: pin will skip the new binary/PR that landed in the canary yesterday. need to call out in release notes that the new feature is deferred if this blocks full release
release-coordinator: ack. also we need a rollback plan if pin doesn't pass: schedule a rollback window at +2h and notify infra on standby
sam: assigning: maya to pin & retrigger, alex to monitor canary run and collect logs, jordan to coordinate release-notes blurb and customer-facing impact if we abort
maya: pinned `redwood/api:canary` -> `sha256:6f7a9c2d` and kicked a canary rebuild: https://ci.internal/redwood/pipelines/6321/builds/9880
maya: triggered with env var `FORCE_CANARY_PIN=true` and `DEPLOY_RETRY=1`
alex: canary build started, baseline smoke tests running...
(10m pass)
alex: first pass looks cleaner, but payments-e2e still has intermittent latency spikes at the same step — not failing yet
jordan: put a note in release notes draft: "Canary pinned to last-good runtime image due to artifact manifest mismatch; feature X deferred from this promo. Investigating artifact indexer replication."
release-coordinator: included a changelog bullet, tagging PM and comms: @product @sw-comm
sam: if the retried canary passes, we still need to fix the indexer replication bug before next full promo. assign to eng-infra postmortem
alex: agreed. opening follow-up ticket ENG-ACCT-1423 for indexer GC vs multipart finalize race
maya: canary passed all smoke + extended e2e now (20m run). ready to attempt promo to staging?
jordan: suggestion: manual promote to staging with a small traffic ramp, keep rollback window open for 60m
release-coordinator: scheduling manual promote now into staging at 15:40Z, change window ok, comms sent to SRE on standby
deploybot: [bot] manual_promote(staging) queued by maya; status: queued -> running
alex: watching logs, promote step reached registry finalize, no 404s so far
sam: confirm artifacts in registry: `curl -I https://registry.internal/v2/redwood/api/manifests/sha256:6f7a9c2d` => 200 OK
maya: promote finished, staging smoke ok. rolling to prod in planned change window at 16:30Z unless any new signs
jordan: we should add a one-liner in release notes: "Promo delayed; pinned to last-known-good image due to artifact digest mismatch; replication fix scheduled."
release-coordinator: done. I'll close thread after prod ramp completes. tagging infra + build team for postmortem: @eng-infra @build-system
alex: thumbs up. if prod ramp shows anything odd we'll trigger rollback plan.
(30m later)
alex: prod ramp healthy at 75% traffic, no regressions in SLOs
release-coordinator: marking release as promoted with pin. Follow-up owners: eng-infra (indexer), build-system (multipart finalize retry)
sam: logging follow-up retrospective item: add guard in deploy-bot to fail-fast on manifest-digest mismatch and auto-skip promote to avoid partial promotions
maya: noted; will open PR to add the guard and add a quick healthcheck on artifact-indexer response freshness
jordan: thanks team. closing this thread. :white_check_mark:
